programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Noongar Country - The Pinnacles WA Part 2
programs.desc: Slow TV is back on NITV with more beautiful Bamay, celebrating stunning landscapes of Countries across Australia. Sit back and relax with the healing powers of Country.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: Tama gets a checkup from Doctor Buzz and Jojo meets a beautiful purerehua. We meet the Starjam Dance Group and learn how important it is to move your tinana.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Do you feel djoorabiny, do you feel happy? Or do you feel menditj, do you feel sick? Make sure you share how you feel with someone who cares. It's moorditj koolangka!

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: Rumour has it that every Halloween, the tiny Humans transform into hideous monsters - including something so unspeakably awful, even grown-ups still have nightmares about it.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: When a terrible loud noise echoes around the rocks, the children fear a monster, or could it be just a burping wombat?

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: The Pyramid of Mu has put our heroes on to the trail of a fresco depicting The Eyes That See All, near an oasis in the desert. But Zares is there too, and attempts to do away with Mendoza.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Kamil challenges Kayne to snaffle an egg from beneath a roosting emu using traditional Wiradjuri methods in one of Bushwhacked's strangest missions yet!

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.desc: Angie wants to turn back time to when her parents were together, so Ben helps her enter Street Art World to seek guidance from a wise graffiti oracle.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: Nico doesn't listen to Viola's warnings and ends up losing his precious turquoise stone during the adventure. In the future, he promises to be more attentive to the advice of the greats.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: Our heroes are back in Arkadia, discouraged at not having discovered the second Orichalcum.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Connie asks 'Why is the sea salty?' and Grandpa spins a tale about a naughty creature named Worsley who lived up a mountain in North Wales and was trying to drink every last drop of the sea!

programs.title: Chums
programs.desc: A baby skunk has a hard time making friends because of her stinky reputation. The Chums set things right with the help of Moise and Maurice the Mooses.
